architecture.early_stop: Any failed, unresolved, malformed, or non-exhaustive commitment/span audit blocks authority reconciliation and terminal completion.
architecture.independence: Neither audit receives owner annotations, expected Case 01 classifications, Humor Mechanics curriculum, or Stage C decisions. Authority reconciliation receives the commitment/span receipt as untrusted audit evidence, not factual authority.
architecture.raw_preservation: Every raw response or exception is persisted before parsing. Controller receipts are append-only and never repair raw output.

records.cardinality: Exactly one record for every frozen ledger entry, in request order; one through eight records.
tuple_rules: Each non-pass decision requires its corresponding reason code.
basis is model-authored analysis, one through 500 Unicode characters, and never source evidence.

validation: Decode base64 strictly and rehash all immutable bytes.
Require all upstream receipts PASS and bound to the same ledger and sources.
Derive ordered_entry_bindings from the frozen ledger and pure projection; caller-authored bindings are rejected.
Require exact set equality between ledger entries and response records.

derived_status.PASS: Every entry has SPAN_SUPPORTS_COMPLETE_COMMITMENT and the schema, source, identity, and coverage checks pass.
derived_status.FAIL: At least one entry has a non-pass, non-unresolved decision or a deterministic validation failure.
derived_status.INDETERMINATE: At least one entry is UNRESOLVED_FAIL_CLOSED or provider/semantic completion is unresolved.

prompt.padding_policy: Exact unpadded UTF-8 instruction bytes; rendered request data follows a separately hashed canonical envelope.

authority_reconciliation_audit_v1.execution_precondition: Commitment/span receipt derived_status PASS. Otherwise this audit is not called.
authority_reconciliation_audit_v1.no_real_world_commitments: When the passed ledger contains zero REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT entries, create a deterministic NO_REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENTS receipt with zero model calls; do not ask a model to confirm an empty set.

records.cardinality: Exactly one record for every REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT, in request order; zero through eight records.
tuple_rules: GOVERNED_SUPPORTED requires a non-null request-bound FACTUAL_AUTHORITY reference, MATCH on event/modality/timing, and no unsupported findings.
UNSUPPORTED_NEW_OR_MUTATED_PROPOSITION requires authority_support_ref null and at least one linked unsupported finding.
NOT_A_REAL_WORLD_COMMITMENT requires authority_support_ref null, NOT_APPLICABLE axes, and no unsupported findings; it makes the upstream ledger inadmissible rather than repairing it.
UNRESOLVED_FAIL_CLOSED requires authority_support_ref null and at least one UNRESOLVED axis.

unsupported_findings.cardinality: Zero through sixteen records; identifiers F1 through F16 are unique and ordered.

validation: Decode and hash immutable authority, candidate, and ledger bytes.
Require the commitment/span receipt PASS and exact identity/source binding.
Derive the real-world entry set from the frozen ledger; caller omission or insertion is rejected.
Constrain authority_support_ref and candidate_proposition_ref with the frozen request-bound character-reference primitive.
Require exact response coverage of every real-world entry and finding link.

derived_status.PASS: Every real-world entry is GOVERNED_SUPPORTED and all tuple, source, identity, and coverage checks pass; or the deterministic zero-entry path applies.
derived_status.FAIL: Any entry is unsupported, not a real-world commitment, structurally invalid, or source-invalid.
derived_status.INDETERMINATE: Any entry or support axis is unresolved, or provider completion is unresolved.

prompt.padding_policy: Exact unpadded UTF-8 instruction bytes; rendered request data follows a separately hashed canonical envelope.

zero_inference_constrained_grammar_analy.not_a_reuse_claim: The frozen full-ledger DFA cannot validate these different response shapes. Only its approved request-bound source-reference primitive and proven character/token projection strategy are reusable dependencies after separate binding.
finite_shape: All root fields and enum choices are finite and canonically ordered.
Commitment records are bounded at eight and authority findings at sixteen.
Entry identifiers and response cardinality are request-bound.
Source hashes and references can use exact literal/request-bound branches.
Free analysis basis strings use the previously characterized bounded JSON STRING mode but carry no evidence authority.
EOS is legal only after the final canonical object byte.
required_future_checks: null versus request-bound reference tuple liveness
Unicode escaping and maximum basis length
real-tokenizer allowed-set equivalence and EOS policy
cache isolation by tokenizer, prompt, schema, request, and source identities

zero_inference_request_compatibility_ana.application_request_boundary: Each future audit request uses a distinct versioned application identity and exact unpadded prompt bytes. No production Core/Voice request identity is reused or modified.
zero_inference_request_compatibility_ana.canonical_envelope: JSON UTF-8, sorted keys for identity, no NaN, strict base64 decoding, byte hashes verified before rendering, and prompt/request identities persisted independently.
zero_inference_request_compatibility_ana.instruction_data_separation: Static prompt precedes labeled canonical data; candidate, authority, ledger, and prior receipts are explicitly untrusted quoted data and cannot supply instructions.
zero_inference_request_compatibility_ana.context_control: Future construction must reject a rendered request exceeding the identity-bound model context before provider launch; truncation is prohibited.
zero_inference_request_compatibility_ana.call_and_retry_control: At most one call per audit, no retry, repair, selection, or unused-budget consumption after failure.
claims_not_made: No concrete Pydantic schema has been implemented.
No character or token grammar has been constructed.
No tokenizer, model, evaluator, runner, subprocess, or probe has been loaded or launched.

case01_design_contract: The frozen Run 3 commitment/span audit must fail before authority reconciliation because its cited spans do not carry the complete claimed meanings.
A future shape-correct ledger may pass commitment/span auditing through more than one valid segmentation.
If a shape-correct ledger emits an off-books-payment factual return, authority reconciliation must compare it with and cite the immutable summary before GOVERNED_SUPPORTED.

If shadow/light/transparency language has no independently surviving real-world proposition, it may remain contained creative; it must not be literalized into NEW_UNSUPPORTED_EVENT by explanatory gloss.
No Case 01 label, expected decision, phrase, or owner annotation appears in either prompt.

blocker_analysis.resolved_design_issue: Allowing model-emitted COMPLETE or audit coverage booleans would recreate circular self-attestation.
blocker_analysis.resolution: Prompts emit only per-entry analysis records; controllers derive record coverage and terminal status from immutable request sets and tuple validation.
remaining_implementation_risks: Semantic audit capability may remain insufficient even with a valid grammar.
Dynamic request-bound cardinality and nested finding links require liveness proof.
Context size must be proven using constructed requests rather than assumed.

recommended_next_step: Owner-review this Phase 2 design. If approved, authorize only separately versioned strict Pydantic contract candidates and pure controller receipt builders for both audits, tested against captured and hand-constructed fixtures; keep prompt rendering, constrained grammar implementation, request construction, tokenizer/model loading, evaluator/runner binding, and probes separately gated.
